revised.test_every_reporting_oracle_declares_wha: IDENTITIES is now mandatory for every reporting oracle, so the test asserts it instead of describing the exemption.
revised.test_registrations_survive_distributed_c: extended to carry the per-field verification basis across the xdist boundary, which the controller was dropping.
revised._merge: merges the basis mapping the workers now ship alongside registrations and covered fields.
revised.pytest_sessionfinish: ships the basis mapping to the controller.
revised.pytest_testnodedown: passes the shipped basis mapping into _merge.
revised.RustSource: no longer carries a hand-written field list; the credit is derived from the file.
revised.rust_covered_fields: derives the credit by intersecting what each file mentions with the mechanism's own fields.
revised.RUST_SOURCES: the hand-transcribed per-source field lists were deleted, 17 of 51 of which named a field absent from the file crediting it.
revised.CIRCULARITY: two unprobed comparisons in the reconstruction oracle were probed and recorded.
revised.Disagreement: the coordinates oracle now refuses an identity absent from its IDENTITIES.
revised.disagreements: the projection oracle's orientation detail moved out of the identity string, which made it raise on a flipped record.
revised._projection_case: gained the flipped-record case that exposed the crash.
revised._coverage_line: can now cover every field of a mechanism, so the registration row reaches `verified` in the test.
revised.test_each_read_is_the_molecule_at_its_ow: relabelled from reference to consistent (both sides are the same projection's output) and the insert_size assertion moved into its own registered test.
revised.test_the_productivity_flags_are_each_der: stopped claiming vj_in_frame, which the oracle derives from the exported junction_length; the assertions are unchanged.
revised.test_an_unresolvable_frame_is_null_rathe: basis corrected from provenance to reference: the expected values come from the fixture's configuration, not from the per-base record.
revised.test_the_junction_string_is_the_molecule: narrowed to junction_aa, the field whose expected value comes from the codon table; junction and junction_length are now established against the reference anchors by their own test.
revised.test_the_alignment_strings_reduce_to_the: narrowed to germline_alignment; sequence_alignment and the D mask are now compared against the recorded molecule and the provenance D span by their own test.
revised.test_germline_coordinates_bound_the_span: the sequence_length assertion moved into its own test registered as consistent, which is what that comparison is; the coordinate assertions are unchanged.
revised.test_the_coverage_report_numbers_are_pin: pinned per mechanism instead of as four counts, and recombination.assembly moved to consistent with the headline falling from 20 to 19.
revised._check: resolves each allele through tests.support.alleles instead of a private copy of the walk, and lets that helper raise on an unresolvable call rather than asserting afterwards.
revised._v_subregions: now a one-line wrapper over tests.support.alleles.v_subregions; kept as a local name because the bodies that claim the per-subregion fields read it.
revised._reporting_oracles: the scan moved into tests.support.oracles.reporting_modules so the circularity probes can use it without importing a test module.

test_recorded_fields_are_owned_by_the_me.why: the guard moved from the hand-written table to the derivation that replaced it; the old name read as if a recorded list were still being checked.

_allele_by_name.why: the private allele walk in the junction tests moved into tests/support/alleles.py as by_name, which raises instead of returning None; three modules had grown their own copy and a fourth would have had to import one of theirs.
